home.metaDescription: Ngā taputapu ā-ipurangi kore utu: kaihanga QR me tohu kuoro, whakamiti me whakaiti whakaahua, whakakotahi/wehe PDF, kaiwhakarite JSON/XML/CSV/Excel, utu, nama, BMI, wā ako, tatau whakamuri me ētahi atu. Ka rere i tō pūtirotiro, kāore he rēhitatanga.
home.lead: Tīpakohia tētahi taputapu, ka whakamahia i tō pūtirotiro. Kāore he rēhitatanga, ā, e kore tō raraunga e wehe i tō pūrere.
home.keywords: ngā taputapu ā-ipurangi, ngā taputapu kore utu, kaihanga QR code, kaihanga tohu kuoro, kaiwhakaiti whakaahua, ngā taputapu PDF, kaiwhakarite kōnae, tātai utu, BMI, ngā taputapu tukutuku

image.name: Ngā Taputapu Whakaahua
image.desc: Whakaitihia, whakamitia, tangohia te papamuri me te tāpiri tohu wai ki ngā whakaahua i tō pūrere.

file.name: Ngā Taputapu Kōnae
file.desc: Whakakotahi/wehe PDF, whakamiti PowerPoint, whakataurite kuputuhi me te whakamiti raraunga.

business.name: Pakihi Ā-ipurangi
business.desc: Ngā taputapu mō ngā toa ā-ipurangi, ngā pakihi iti me ngā kaimahi motuhake.

finance.name: Pūtea me ngā Tātai
finance.desc: Ngā tātai tika mā te tātai me ngā ture o nāianei.

marketing.name: Hokohoko
marketing.desc: Ngā QR code, ngā hono pakanga me ngā tae waitohu.

life.name: Whaihua me te Oranga
life.desc: Ngā taputapu whaihua mō ia rā.

health.name: Hauora
health.desc: Aroturuki taumaha, kai, wai, mahi tinana me te huringa.

edu.name: Mātauranga me te Ako
edu.desc: Ngā wā ako, ngā pātai, te rārangi tae, ngā mapi hinengaro me te utu.

time.name: Ngā Taputapu Wā
time.desc: Ngā karaka, ngā tatau whakamuri, ngā rohe wā, ngā rā mahi me te tuhinga rā.

dev.name: Ngā Taputapu Kaihanga
dev.desc: Whakatakotoria, arotakea, whakamuna, whakamitia hoki te waehere pūtake.

text.name: Ngā Taputapu Kuputuhi
text.desc: Huria te momo pūāhua, ngā momotuhi whakapaipai mō ngā pāpāho pāpori, te kuputuhi ki te kōrero me te tuhi reo.

calc.name: Ngā Tātai me ngā Whakamiti
calc.desc: Tātai pūtaiao, ngā ōrau me te whakamiti wae.

device.name: Ngā Whakamātau Pūrere
device.desc: Whakamātauria tō kāmera tukutuku, hopukina tō mata, ineinetia te tere patapatai me ngā pāwhiri ia hēkona.

media.name: Oro me te Ataata
media.desc: Whakaitihia te ataata, tangohia te oro MP3 me te whakatangi i tō kitā i roto i te pūtirotiro.

excel.name: Tukatuka raraunga Excel
excel.desc: Whakakī Word mai i Excel, whakakotahi ngāwhā, whakapūnga rārangi, me te whakakotahi i ētahi whārangi, kōnae Excel rānei ki te tātai.

entertainment.name: Ngahau me ngā Tākaro
entertainment.desc: Wira waimarie, kaihanga tau matapōkere, tōkahi taonga me ngā kēmu ngahau.

image-convert.name: Whakaiti Whakaahua
image-convert.desc: Whakaitihia te rahi o te kōnae whakaahua, whakaitihia ngā whakaahua maha i te wā kotahi kia tere ake te tuku ki te tukutuku me te īmēra.

image-format.name: Whakamiti Whakatakotoranga Whakaahua
image-format.desc: Whakamitia ngā whakaahua i waenga i a JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, BMP me ICO (favicon) mō ngā pae tukutuku, ngā taupānga, te penapena rānei.

image-base64.name: Whakaahua ki Base64
image-base64.desc: Huria ngā whakaahua hei aho Base64 hei whakauru ki HTML, CSS, waehere rānei, ā, huria a Base64 hei whakaahua anō.

bg-remove.name: Tango Papamuri Whakaahua
bg-remove.desc: Tangohia te papamuri mā, te papamuri tae kotahi rānei i ngā whakaahua hua, ngā tohu me ngā whakaahua kaiwhakamahi, i tō pūrere tonu.

watermark.name: Tāpiri Tohu Wai ki ngā Whakaahua
watermark.desc: Tāpirihia he kuputuhi, he tohu, he tohu mana pupuri rānei ki tētahi, ki ngā whakaahua maha i te wā kotahi.

pdf-merge.name: Whakakotahi me te Wehe PDF
pdf-merge.desc: Whakakotahia ngā kōnae PDF maha hei kotahi, tangohia ngā whārangi e hiahiatia ana, wehea rānei he PDF whārangi ki te whārangi.

pptx-pdf.name: PowerPoint ↔ PDF
pptx-pdf.desc: Whakamitia ngā kitenga PowerPoint (.pptx) ki PDF, ā, huria ngā kōnae PDF hei PowerPoint.

file-diff.name: Whakataurite Kōnae E Rua
file-diff.desc: Kimihia ngā rerekētanga i waenga i ngā kuputuhi e rua: TXT, Word, HTML, PDF kuputuhi rānei. Ka tohua ngā wāhanga i tāpiritia, i tangohia, i rerekētia hoki.

text-analysis.name: Tātari Kuputuhi
text-analysis.desc: Tatauhia ngā kupu, ngā pūāhua, ngā rerenga me ngā kōwae, whakatauhia te wā pānui me te kiato kupu matua mō te kuputuhi, TXT, Word, PDF rānei.

data-convert.name: Whakamiti JSON, XML, CSV, Excel
data-convert.desc: Whakamitia te raraunga i waenga i a JSON, XML, CSV me Excel (.xlsx) me te arokite ripanga.

bmi-bmr.name: Tātai BMI me BMR
bmi-bmr.desc: Tātaihia te taurangi papatipu tinana (BMI), te ōwehenga hope-hope me ngā hiahia karori (BMR, TDEE) mā te pakeke, te ira tāne/wahine me te taumata mahi.

meal-calo.name: Kaituhi Kai me Karori Ia Rā
meal-calo.desc: Whakamahere kai mā te whāinga karori, tirohia ngā karori o ngā kai noa me te whakatairite i te pūmua, te warowaiwaiwha me te ngako.

water-tracker.name: Aroturuki Inu Wai
water-tracker.desc: Whakaritea he whāinga ia rā ka tuhia te nui o te wai e inumia ana e koe, me te ahu whakamua me te hītori maha-rā.

calo-burn.name: Karori Kua Pau mā te Mahi
calo-burn.desc: Whakatauhia ngā karori kua pau mā te hākinakina, te mahi, te roanga me te taumaha tinana mā ngā uara MET.

cycle-track.name: Aroturuki Huringa Marama
cycle-track.desc: Tuhia, matapae hoki tō huringa marama, te rā hanga hua me te wā whai uri. Ka noho ngā raraunga ki tō pūrere anake.

study-timetable.name: Wā Ako
study-timetable.desc: Hangaia he wā akoranga ā-wiki mā ia wā; tāia, tiakina rānei hei whakamahi anō ia rā.

quiz-bank.name: Pātai me te Pēke Pātai
quiz-bank.desc: Hangaia he pēke pātai kōwhiringa maha, whakaranuhia ngā pātai, whakamātauria he whakamātautau whakaharatau kua mākahia, ā, tāia te whakamātautau me ngā whakautu.

attendance.name: Rārangi Tae
attendance.desc: Hangaia he rārangi akomanga, tikina te tae ia wā, aroturukitia ngā ngaro me ngā tae tōmuri. Ka taea te tukutahi ki Google Sheets.

mindmap.name: Mapi Hinengaro me te Whakarāpopoto
mindmap.desc: Tuhia ngā mapi hinengaro mō ngā akoranga, ā, whakarāpopototia aunoa ngā kuputuhi roa hei ngā take matua.

teaching-pay.name: Haora Whakaako me te Utu
teaching-pay.desc: Tuhia ngā wā whakaako, tāpirihia ngā haora me te utu mā te reiti, ā, kaweakehia he tauākī.

fullscreen-clock.name: Karaka Mata Katoa
fullscreen-clock.desc: He karaka mamati nui mata katoa me te mātai wā me te tatau whakamuri, ngā tae, te momotuhi me te whakatakotoranga 12/24 haora ka taea te whakarite.

countdown-video.name: Kaihanga Ataata Tatau Whakamuri
countdown-video.desc: Hangaia he pātā tatau whakamuri ka taea te whakarite, ā, tikiakehia hei ataata hei whakauru ki ō kopae.

world-clock.name: Karaka o te Ao
world-clock.desc: Tirohia te wā o nāianei i ngā whenua maha i te wā kotahi, ā, whakaritea ngā rerekētanga rohe wā i waenga i a rātou.

workdays.name: Tātai Rā Mahi
workdays.desc: Tatauhia ngā rā mahi i waenga i ngā rā e rua, haunga ngā Rāhoroi, ngā Rātapu me ngā hararei a te marea.

journal.name: Tuhinga Rā Ā-ipurangi
journal.desc: Tuhia he tuhinga rā ia rā, e tiakina matatapu ana ki tō Google Sheet ake, māu anake e pānui.

code-format.name: Whakatakoto JS, HTML, CSS, JSON
code-format.desc: Whakawhitihia, whakaraupapatia hoki te waehere JavaScript, HTML, CSS me JSON.

code-check.name: Kaitirotiro Wetereo
code-check.desc: Kimihia ngā hapa wetereo me te hanganga i JavaScript, HTML, CSS me JSON, me te rārangi me te tīwae.

js-obfuscate.name: Kaiwhakapōuri JavaScript
js-obfuscate.desc: Whakawaehere i ngā aho, whakaingoa anō i ngā taurangi ka whakapōuri i te JavaScript kia uaua te pānui me te tārua.

rsa-keys.name: Ngā Kī RSA me te Whakawaehere
rsa-keys.desc: Hangaia he takirua kī RSA (PEM), whakawaeheretia te kuputuhi ki te kī tūmatanui, ā, whakawetetia ki te kī matatapu, i tō pūrere katoa.

text-to-html.name: Kuputuhi Whai Āhua ki HTML
text-to-html.desc: Whakatikahia ā-kite mā te tuhi mātotoru, ngā ū, ngā rārangi, ngā ripanga me ngā hononga, ā, whakawhiwhia he waehere HTML ma.

inventory.name: Rawa Whakaemi me te Utu
inventory.desc: Whakaritea ngā utu hoko mai i ngā utu o te mākete, ngā pānui me te tohu hua. Aroturukitia te taonga ka uru, ka puta, me ngā whakatūpato taonga iti.

invoice.name: Nama me te Whakatau Utu
invoice.desc: Hangaia he whakatau utu me ngā nama hoko me te tohu, ngā tapeke aunoa me te moni ki ngā kupu. Tāia, tiakina rānei hei PDF.

menu-qr.name: Tahua QR
menu-qr.desc: Hangaia he tahua mamati mō ngā wharekai me ngā kawhe. Ka matawai ngā kiritaki i tētahi QR code hei tiro i ngā kai me ngā utu.

barcode.name: Kaihanga Tohu Kuoro
barcode.desc: Hangaia ngā tohu kuoro Code 128, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A me Code 39 mō ngā tapanga hua me te whare taonga.

loan.name: Tātai Nama
loan.desc: Te utu ia marama, te katoa o te huamoni me te wā utu mō ngā nama whare, waka, kaihoko hoki.

compound.name: Huamoni Pūhui me te Penapena
compound.desc: Matapaetia te nui o tā koe e kohikohi ai mā te penapena, te haumi rānei ia marama.

salary.name: Utu Gross ↔ Net
salary.desc: Whakamitia te utu Gross ki te Net, ā, whakamuri, e whai ana i ngā ture inihua me te tāke moni whiwhi whaiaro 2026 (Wīetināma).

qr-code.name: Kaihanga QR Code
qr-code.desc: Hangaia ngā QR code mō ngā hononga, te kuputuhi, te Wi‑Fi, te īmēra me ngā tau waea. Tikiakehia hei PNG, SVG rānei.

utm.name: Kaihanga Hono UTM
utm.desc: Tāpirihia ngā waehere aroturuki pakanga ki ngā hononga kia kitea nā tēhea ara tō ngā manuhiri.

colors.name: Tae Tauira me ngā Waehere
colors.desc: Hangaia he tauira tae e rite ana mai i tētahi tae pūtake, ā, whiwhia ngā waehere HEX, RGB, HSL me ngā taurangi CSS.

expense.name: Whakapaunga me te Tahua Pūtea
expense.desc: Tuhia ngā moni whiwhi me ngā whakapaunga ia rā, tirohia te whakapaunga mā ia momo, ā, whakaritea ngā tepe kia noho ki te tahua pūtea.

habit.name: Aroturuki Tikanga me te Raupapa
habit.desc: Tohua ngā tikanga ia rā ka aroturuki i ngā raupapa rā-ā-muri kia mau tonu te tika.

cv.name: Kaihanga Tuhinga Whakarāpopoto (CV)
cv.desc: Whakakīia he tauira me te arokite ora, tīpakohia he whakaritenga me tētahi tae, ā, tāia, tiakina rānei hei PDF, kore utu.

currency-time.name: Moni me ngā Rohe Wā
currency-time.desc: Whakamitia ngā moni ki ngā reiti hou rawa, ā, tirohia te wā i ngā tāone puta noa i te ao.

image-resize.name: Kaiwhakarerekē Rahi Whakaahua
image-resize.desc: Whakarerekētia te rahi o ngā whakaahua mā te pika, te ōrau rānei, pupuri i te ōwehenga āhua me te tukatuka i ngā whakaahua maha i te wā kotahi.

image-crop.name: Tapahi Whakaahua
image-crop.desc: Tapahia ngā whakaahua ā-noa, ki te 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 me te 9:16 rānei, ā, huria, tahuri rānei i mua i te tikiake.

image-ocr.name: Whakaahua ki Kuputuhi (OCR)
image-ocr.desc: Tangohia te kuputuhi mai i ngā whakaahua, ngā hopukanga mata me ngā tuhinga kua matawai. E tautoko ana i te reo Ingarihi me te neke atu i te 30 atu reo.

heic-jpg.name: HEIC ki JPG
heic-jpg.desc: Whakamitia ngā whakaahua HEIC a iPhone ki JPG, PNG rānei kia tuwhera ai ki ia wāhi. E tautoko ana i te whakamiti ā-pūranga.

image-upscale.name: Kaiwhakanui Whakaahua AI
image-upscale.desc: Whakanuia ngā whakaahua 2× 4× rānei, ā, whakamāramahia ngā taipitopito mā te AI. He pai mō ngā whakaahua iti, kōpikopiko, tawhito rānei.

image-to-pdf.name: Whakaahua ki PDF
image-to-pdf.desc: Whakakotahia ngā whakaahua JPG me PNG hei PDF kotahi, whakaraupapatia anōtia ngā whārangi, ā, tīpakohia te rahi pepa me ngā taha.

pdf-to-image.name: PDF ki Whakaahua
pdf-to-image.desc: Huria ia whārangi PDF hei JPG, PNG mārama rānei, tīpakohia te whakatau, tikiakehia ngā whakaahua takitahi, he ZIP rānei.

pdf-compress.name: Whakaiti PDF
pdf-compress.desc: Whakaitihia te rahi o te kōnae PDF mō te īmēra me ngā puka ā-ipurangi. Tīpakohia tētahi taumata whakaiti, ka whakataurite i ngā rahi.

pdf-to-word.name: PDF ki Word
pdf-to-word.desc: Whakamitia te PDF ki tētahi kōnae Word (.docx) ka taea te whakatika, e pupuri ana i te kuputuhi me ngā kōwae, pupuri rānei i te whakatakotoranga whārangi hei whakaahua.

word-to-pdf.name: Word ki PDF
word-to-pdf.desc: Whakamitia ngā kōnae Word (.docx) ki PDF i tō pūtirotiro, arokite, ka tikiake, ka tā rānei.

pdf-sign.name: Hainatia PDF
pdf-sign.desc: Tuhia, patapatai rānei i tō hainatanga, tāpirihia he hainatanga whakaahua me te rā, tuhia ki ngā whārangi PDF, ā, tikiakehia.

pdf-edit.name: Whakatika PDF me te Whakakī Puka
pdf-edit.desc: Tāpirihia te kuputuhi, ngā tohu tika me ngā pouaka whakaparahako ki ngā PDF, ā, whakakīa ngā wāhi puka o mua.

case-convert.name: Kaiwhakarerekē Pūmatua
case-convert.desc: Whakamitia te kuputuhi ki te PŪMATUA, te pūriki, te Pūmatua Ia Kupu, te Pūmatua Rerenga, te camelCase, te snake_case me ētahi atu.

fancy-text.name: Kaihanga Kuputuhi Whakapaipai
fancy-text.desc: Huria te kuputuhi noa ki te neke atu i te 30 momotuhi ātaahua mō Instagram, TikTok, ngā pūkete Facebook me ngā ingoa tākaro. Tāruatia mā te pāwhiri kotahi.

text-to-speech.name: Kuputuhi ki te Kōrero
text-to-speech.desc: Pānuitia te kuputuhi i te reo nui mā ngā reo o tō pūrere. Tīpakohia te reo, te tere me te teitei. E tautoko ana i ngā reo maha.

speech-to-text.name: Kōrero ki te Kuputuhi
speech-to-text.desc: Tuhia mā tō reo: kōrero ki te hohe ororongo ka kite i te kuputuhi e puta ana, ā, tāruatia, tikiakehia rānei.

scientific-calc.name: Tātai Pūtaiao
scientific-calc.desc: Tātai ā-ipurangi me te tikanga tapatoru, ngā taurangi taurahi, ngā pūtoru, ngā pūtake, te tau tū, ngā nekehanga/radians, te mahara me te hītori.

percentage.name: Tātai Ōrau
percentage.desc: Kimihia te X% o Y, te ōrau o X i roto i a Y, te huringa ōrau me te utu hokohoko, me ngā tātai ā-taahu.

unit-convert.name: Kaiwhakamiti Wae
unit-convert.desc: Whakamitia te roa, te taumaha, te pāmahana, te horahanga, te rōrahi, te tere, te wā, te raraunga, te pēhanga me te kaha.

age-calc.name: Tātai Pakeke
age-calc.desc: Tātaihia te pakeke tika ki ngā tau, ngā marama me ngā rā, te tapeke o ngā rā kua ora, te rā whānau e whai ake nei me te tohu whetū.

date-calc.name: Tātai Rā
date-calc.desc: Tatauhia ngā rā i waenga i ngā rā e rua, tāpiri, tango rānei i ngā rā, ngā wiki, ngā marama me ngā tau, ā, tirohia te rā o te wiki.

gpa.name: Tātai GPA
gpa.desc: Tātaihia te GPA o te wāhanga me te GPA huihui mā ngā whiwhinga i runga i te tauine 4.0 me ngā reta kōeke.

due-date.name: Tātai Rā Whānau
due-date.desc: Whakatauhia tō rā whānau me te wiki hapūtanga mai i te marama whakamutunga, te rā hapū, te pūatahi rānei, me ngā tohu matua.

spin-wheel.name: Hurihia te Wīra
spin-wheel.desc: Hangaia he wīra me ngā ingoa, ngā taonga whakawhiwhi rānei, hurihia ā-matapōkere, tangohia ngā toa, aratau mata katoa.

random-number.name: Kaihanga Tau Matapōkere
random-number.desc: Hangaia ngā tau matapōkere i tētahi whānuitanga ahakoa, maha i te wā kotahi, me te kore rānei he pūrua, mō ngā tōia me ngā tākaro.

typing-test.name: Whakamātau Tere Patapatai
typing-test.desc: Ineinetia tō tere patapatai (WPM) me te tika i te 30 hēkona ki te 5 meneti.

cps-test.name: Whakamātau CPS (Tere Pāwhiri)
cps-test.desc: Tatauhia ngā pāwhiri ia hēkona i te 1 ki te 60 hēkona, pupuri i tō piro pai rawa, whakamātauria te pae mokowā me te ppa hoki.

webcam-test.name: Whakamātau Kāmera Tukutuku
webcam-test.desc: Tirohia mēnā e mahi ana tō kāmera, kitea te whakatau me te tere anga, whakawhitia ngā kāmera ka tango whakaahua whakamātau.

screen-recorder.name: Kaihopu Mata
screen-recorder.desc: Hopukina tō mata, tētahi matapihi, tētahi ripa rānei me te oro pūnaha me te hohe ororongo, kāore he tāutanga e hiahiatia.

video-compress.name: Kaiwhakaiti Ataata
video-compress.desc: Whakaitihia ngā kōnae MP4, MOV me WebM mō te tuku karere, te īmēra me ngā pāpāho pāpori. Tīpakohia te whakatau me te kounga.

video-to-mp3.name: Ataata ki MP3
video-to-mp3.desc: Tangohia te oro i ngā ataata MP4, MOV me WebM hei MP3, tīpakohia te kounga, ā, tapahia te wāhanga e hiahiatia ana.

guitar-tuner.name: Kaiwhakatangi Kitā
guitar-tuner.desc: Whakatangihia te kitā, te ukulele me te pāhi mā tō hohe ororongo: te oro, te rerekē sēne me te ngira, tae atu ki ngā oro tohutoro.

password-gen.name: Kaihanga Kupuhipa
password-gen.desc: Hangaia ngā kupuhipa matapōkere pakari, ngā kīanga hipa maumahara hoki, tīpakohia te roa me ngā pūāhua, tirohia te kaha.

signature.name: Kaihanga Hainatanga
signature.desc: Tuhia tō hainatanga mā te kiore, mā te maihi rānei, patapatai rānei ki ngā momotuhi ringaringa; tikiakehia he PNG kitea-ma.

logo-maker.name: Kaihanga Tohu
logo-maker.desc: Hangaia he tohu mai i tētahi ikona, ingoa waitohu me te kōrero poto; tīpakohia ngā momotuhi, ngā tae me te whakatakotoranga, tikiakehia he SVG, PNG rānei.

notepad.name: Pukapuka Tuhi Ā-ipurangi
notepad.desc: Ngā tuhipoka tere ka tiakina aunoa i tō pūtirotiro: tuhipoka maha, rapunga, tatau kupu me te tikiake TXT.

excel-word-fill.name: Whakakī Word mai i Excel
excel-word-fill.desc: Ka tango ihirangi mai i tētahi kōnae Excel ka whakauru ki ngā tohu o tētahi kōnae Word, me ngā upoko tau ki te whero.

excel-cell-merge.name: Whakakotahi ngāwhā Excel mai i ētahi whārangi / kōnae
excel-cell-merge.desc: Ka whakakotahi i te ngāwhā ōrite (A1, B2...) mai i ētahi whārangi, kōnae Excel rānei ki tētahi, me te whakatūpato mō ngā ngāwhā he raraunga i neke atu i te kotahi pūtake.

excel-row-concat.name: Whakapūnga rārangi Excel mai i ētahi whārangi / kōnae
excel-row-concat.desc: Ka whakapūnga i ētahi whārangi, kōnae Excel rānei ki runga ki raro hei tūtohi roa kotahi. Kotahi te rārangi pane, ka whakarērea ngā rārangi kau.

excel-formula-merge.name: Whakakotahi raraunga Excel ki te tātai
excel-formula-merge.desc: Ka whakakotahi i ētahi whārangi, kōnae Excel rānei ki te tātai mō ia ngāwhā (SUM, IF, CONCAT, UNIQUE...), ngā ritenga kōpuku, me ngā tātai kua tiakina e taea ai te whakamahi anō.

I te mea ka taea e RSA te whakawaehere i ngā raraunga poto rawa anake, ka whakamahi te taputapu i te whakawaehere ranu: ka hanga i tētahi kī AES matapōkere hei whakawaehere i te kuputuhi, ka takai i taua kī AES ki a RSA — nō reira ka taea te whakawaehere i te kuputuhi o tētahi roa ahakoa. Me whai te kaiwhiwhi i te kī matatapu e hāngai ana hei whakawete. Ka taea te tohatoha i te kī tūmatanui (SPKI); me tiaki huna te kī matatapu (PKCS#8).

typing-test.texts: Ia ata ka maranga wawe au ka oma haere huri noa i te roto. Ka whakawātea te hau hou i tōku hinengaro, ā, ka reri ahau mō tētahi rā hou i te mahi. I muri mai ka kai parakuihi ahau me tōku whānau, ka pānui i ētahi whārangi o tētahi pukapuka, ka tīmata i tōku rā. Ko ngā tikanga iti e mahia ana ia rā ka huri hei panoni nunui i te roanga o te wā.|He rerekē, he whānui hoki ngā whenua o Aotearoa, mai i ngā takutai onepū o Te Tai Tokerau ki ngā tihi hukarere o Te Tiritiri o te Moana. Ka taea e ngā manuhiri te hīkoi i te Tongariro Alpine Crossing, te tāpoi i Rotorua, te haere rānei ki ngā tiriti kīkī o Tāmaki Makaurau. He āhua motuhake tō ia rohe.|He pūkenga whaihua te ako ki te patapatai kore-titiro mā te tangata e mahi ana ki te rorohiko. Ina taunga koe, kāore koe e hiahia ana ki te titiro ki te papapātene, ka piki tō tere patapatai, ā, ka iti ake ngā hapa. Whakaharatauhia mō te tekau mā rima meneti ia rā, whai whakaaro ki te tika i te tuatahi, ā, ka whakapiki puhoi i tō tere.
